name: Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE), Far Detector Technical Design Report, Volume II: DUNE Physics

summary.plain: The physics case: why DUNE is built the way it is, and what it should be able to measure about neutrinos, supernovae and proton decay.
summary.technical: DUNE FD TDR Vol. II (arXiv:2002.03005, Feb 2020): sensitivity projections for CP violation, the mass ordering, supernova-burst neutrinos, nucleon decay and BSM searches.
